steps.message: The package diff between `5.5.1` and `5.6.4` does not add stricter React preset rules; the local source also has no upgraded-plugin lint failures. I’m going to narrow the Testing Library and jest-dom ESLint presets to actual test files. That keeps the upgraded plugin active for the test oracle while avoiding project-wide aggressive Testing Library detection in application source.
